howItWorks.title: How Does Viven Capital Work?
howItWorks.description: Real estate investment fund with targeted 12% returns in under 12 months.

step1.title: Invest in a property
step1.desc: Viven Capital allows you to participate via equity or debt in vetted real estate projects with certified partners.

step2.title: Earn high yields
step2.desc: Upon investment exit, you receive your initial capital back alongside your proportional share of profits.

step3.title: Diversify like professionals
step3.desc: Build a robust portfolio diversified across property types, prime locations, time horizons, and asset classes.

process.description: We manage the entire property lifecycle: from acquisition to exit, through renovation, permitting, and value creation. The investor participates completely hands-off.

step1.title: Direct purchase or adjudication
step1.desc: We identify and acquire undervalued assets with a margin of safety: court auctions, bank repossessions, and direct off-market owners.

step2.title: Legal regularization and handover
step2.desc: We handle tenancy regularizations whenever necessary, with rigorous legal backing and full regulatory compliance.

step3.title: Technical inspection
step3.desc: Structural, architectural, and documentary audit before intervention. Fixed-price budget with zero surprises.

step4.title: Full renovation
step4.desc: Our in-house architecture and construction teams coordinate complete turnkey renovations, elevating asset value.

step5.title: Updated legal documentation
step5.desc: Occupancy licenses, building inspections, energy certificates, and registry encumbrance clearance: fully certified turnkey asset.

step6.title: Sale and investor returns
step6.desc: Market launch with our proprietary sales network. Generated capital gains translate directly into investor profits.
